title: fix(mcp): initialize points at the served SKILL.md; run_action names the no_confirmation_service next step
body:
Fixes #35778

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化:连接开放 MCP 入口的 AI 客户端,初始化时会被告知使用指南在哪里下载;执行需人工确认的业务动作被拒时,工具说明会告诉它由人在应用里完成。
- 为什么做:上一轮把教学文字从工具说明挪进了使用指南,不读指南的客户端失去了指引,这里补回两句提示(属于"让自带 AI 的客户端在开放入口拿到受治理答案"这条主线)。
- 出错会怎样:只是给 AI 读的提示文字,说错了 AI 可能找错地址或多问一句,不会改数据;可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes
Items 1 and 2 of #35778. **Item 3 (optional slimming of list_datasets / query_dataset, the spec `QueryDatasetInputSchema` and the validate_expression variable descriptions) is not taken**: the card marks it optional and measure-first, and it stays open on the card.

1. `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`: the open door's default `initialize` text (`DEFAULT_HTTP_INSTRUCTIONS`) gains one sentence:
   `Usage guide (SKILL.md): GET this endpoint's path plus /skill (by default /api/v1/mcp/skill).`
   - Where it is true: the runtime dispatcher mounts `GET PREFIX/mcp/skill` beside `PREFIX/mcp` from the same domain list (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` `createMcpDomains`, mounted in `dispatcher-plugin.ts` with the same `prefix`, default `/api/v1`), behind the same `isMcpServerEnabled()` switch, answered by the same `mcp` service (`renderSkill`), and anonymous, so it holds for every grant. `handleHttpRequest`'s only caller in this repo is that domain. The sentence is relative to the endpoint because the prefix is configurable.
   - Where it is not added: a host's per-request texts and a configured `instructions` stay whole (existing pins), and the stdio default names no URL, since a stdio server has no HTTP endpoint.
2. `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`: `run_action`'s description gains one clause after the ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED sentence:
   `On details.reason "no_confirmation_service" a person performs it in the app: do not make the same change with another tool.`
   - It restores the pre-#35682 in-app hint, and adds the "not through another tool" half the qa record on #34325 (6966146204) asks the refusal wording to carry. It is door-neutral: true on stdio and on Streamable HTTP. It does not anticipate #34325's stdio-only sentence (use a client that supports confirmation), which belongs to the refusal text on that card, and stays consistent with ruling 6909391261 (HTTP keeps the hand-off path; cancel/timeout refused).

Byte deltas:
- tools/list on the API-key surface (`tools-list-weight-34689.test.ts`): 36,613 to 36,739 bytes (+126); `run_action` description 1,228 to 1,352 (+124). The ceiling of 38,000 is unchanged and still holds.
- Default `initialize` text: +93 bytes (a bare bridge answers 533 characters). The 4,096-character bound pin on the longest default text still passes.

## Tests
- New top-level describes in the existing harness files:
  - `initialize-selection-rule-34686.test.ts`: the pointer is in the first paragraph for five grants (no scope, data:read, data:write, metadata:write with an authoring injection, data:read with one).
  - `mcp-action-confirmation-handoff-33690.test.ts`: `run_action`'s tools/list description carries the clause.
- Ablations, one-off, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 to 0, restored blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty). The tests import the source, so no dist rebuild sits in the path:
  - pointer removed: the new initialize pin fails (1 failed, 14 passed);
  - clause removed: the new run_action pin fails (1 failed, 28 passed).

## Acceptance notes
- Not verified: a cloud host that calls `handleHttpRequest` from its own code and mounts the MCP endpoint without the runtime dispatcher. Such a host gets this default only when it injects no instructions of its own. If it serves no sibling `/skill` path, the sentence would not hold there; nothing in this repo is such a caller.
